discovery_command.selection: Literal immutable snapshot prefixes and five source/text suffixes

purpose: Lookup exact original SHA256 references against existing immutable source snapshots; not a requirement to publish every indexed file
scope: Text/program/schema files in campaign116 source-* and qualification-*-source snapshots plus fixed frozen inputs. No Samples, binaries, runtime, numerical code execution, other/private branch, reconstruction or source edit. Only exact requested hash matches may resolve a historical reference.
